implementation.owner: Private dx_data import ledger, entered only by dx_iface::fileImport's actual DWG read scope
implementation.metadata: One shared immutable Rows owner with fixed scalar rows and one flat UTF-8 arena, not mutable public callback copies
implementation.source: Private copied source/profile report sharing the existing immutable byte owner, not the advisory public-generation lookup
implementation.identity: Private monotonic actual-attempt counter, expected public label and exclusive data/adapter read owner; direct reader result/version/codepage at seal
contextRefusals: Reused public label and historical collision
Failed/non-DWG attempt cannot reuse an older current report
implementation.budget: Logical sizes preflight before snapshot allocation; actual row/arena/source capacities checked before publication. Failed active entries/buffers are released and refunded at seal, with a fixed failure result. Successful historical owners remain charged. Advisory/public model budgets remain separate, not a process-wide peak-memory guarantee.
implementation.join: All syntactically complete source candidates are enumerated independently of expected values. Every scalar, ordinal, descriptor, normalized name and range/address-space/publication field must match the immutable baseline for every framed candidate.
implementation.text: Encoded-unit convention selection precedes expected UTF-8 comparison; exact and one-final-NUL forms are explicit. Unknown codepages, invalid Unicode and repeated/interior NULs remain refused.
implementation.inspectionBoundary: Joined is table/source correlation, not schema, semantic, raster, editable CLASS output, document or support admission. Failure zero counts are unknown, not a qualified empty table.

workSharing.observer: observeSectionTails shares one independent record/CRC prerequisite per common profile; every tail separately verifies END/extension/envelope accounting.
workSharing.binding: Common scalar/text streams are matched once, with every framed and matched candidate retained in masks; a proper matched subset fails rather than selecting a convenient profile.
